name: 92203 · Indio, CA
findings: ZIP 92203 (Indio) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92203 (Indio) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92203 (Indio) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 27% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
